# Photo to Organic Knit

Curated by Skill Harbor — reimagines a user-supplied photograph as a concept-driven knitted-wool art poster rather than a literal textile filter: a structured 12-step workflow (inspect the source, sort elements into retain/transform/discard, write a one-sentence art direction, recompose rather than trace), handmade-irregularity rules (uneven stitch tension, loose ends, wispy fibers), yarn-lettering guidance for a 2–4 word title, and a full invariant list (orientation preserved, editorial restraint, no plastic/clay surfaces). Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @nalazhang27. Honest caveats: works with an image-generation flow (ImageGen) — you need a Muse with image generation; the skill references `assets/style-reference.png` and `references/style-spec.md`, so install the helper files too, not just the SKILL.md; 3 installs on the catalog, but popularity is not a review. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
